Method of Attack: Retrieves additional malicious script from an external source
Runs a Discord bot to give attackers full control over the victim's computer
Downloads files from the victim's system
Captures screenshots and records screen and audio
Deactivates Windows Defender and Task Manager
Controls the computer's camera to take photos
Discoverer: Checkmarx Supply Chain Security solution research team
Impacted Systems: Systems using Python packages for code obfuscation
Attack Vector: Malicious Python packages disguised as legitimate obfuscation tools
External script execution via setup.py and init.py files
